sentence: By 2026-10-25, reviewers objected to or removed 20 of the 245 files the rules listed (8%), no more often than 227 of the 1593 files they did not list (14%): on this sample, the list did not pick out what reviewers acted on. The listed files acted on came from 5 of the 60 pull requests with a listed file. Of the 68 listed files in merged pull requests, 68 landed with nobody objecting.
